scripts.check: pnpm format && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build && pnpm contracts:check && pnpm security:secrets
scripts.contracts:generate: uv run --frozen python -m scripts.generate_contracts && pnpm --filter @simula/contracts generate
scripts.format: prettier --check .github apps/web packages/contracts package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml prettier.config.mjs README.md compose.yaml tsconfig.base.json turbo.json && uv run --frozen ruff format --check .
scripts.format:fix: prettier --write .github apps/web packages/contracts package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml prettier.config.mjs README.md compose.yaml tsconfig.base.json turbo.json && uv run --frozen ruff format .
scripts.lint: turbo run lint && uv run --frozen ruff check .
scripts.test: turbo run test && uv run --frozen pytest -m "not integration"
scripts.test:integration: pnpm redis:up && uv run --frozen pytest -m integration
scripts.typecheck: turbo run typecheck && uv run --frozen mypy services packages/simula-core scripts tests
scripts.verify:m1-database: supabase db reset --local --yes && supabase db reset --local --yes && pnpm supabase:lint && pnpm supabase:test && uv run --frozen pytest tests/integration/test_database_boundary.py -m integration && pnpm database:types:check
scripts.verify:m2-api: pnpm redis:up && supabase db reset --local --yes && supabase db reset --local --yes && pnpm supabase:lint && pnpm supabase:test && uv run --frozen pytest services/api/tests -q && uv run --frozen pytest tests/integration/test_database_boundary.py tests/integration/test_api_m2.py tests/integration/test_rate_limits.py -m integration && pnpm database:types:check && pnpm contracts:check
